_doc: Allow-list of DELIBERATE holds for scripts/qa/deadframes.py (v1's run_all.sh, archived since 2026-10-29 in archive/v1/scripts/qa/, read this file by default). A dead run that lies inside an entry's window is reported but not flagged. Entries: {"scene": "S05", "t0": 1.2, "t1": 2.4, "why": "..."} with scene-local seconds, or {"t0": 33.0, "t1": 34.1, "why": "..."} with film seconds. Every hold needs a why, and the creative lead's OK.
